title: Validation failures return 422 rather than the spec's 400
evidence: lib/book_api/router.ex:71 handle_error/2 maps is_map(errors) to json(conn, 422, ...); REQUIREMENTS.json R9 how_to_verify expects 400
suggestion: 422 Unprocessable Entity is semantically defensible for validation errors, but return 400 if strict spec conformance to the stated code is required
